day_local: Jimcaha Toddobaadkii Soddon iyo Saddexaad ee Wakhtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jireen.
penitential:

psalm_response: R. Sidee bay ballankaagu u macaan yahay dhadhankayga!
homily:
Bal ka fikir adigoo gacanta ku haya wax aad u yar, wax aad u jilicsan, oo aad ogtahay inuu leeyahay miisaan ka weyn inta ay indhahaagu arki karaan. Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, Yooxanaa waxaa loo diray inuu qaato duub yar oo uu liqo. Malaa'igtu waxay ku tiri: 'Qaado oo liq; calooshaada ayuu ka dhigi doonaa mid qadhaadh, laakiin afkaaga wuxuu ka noqon doonaa sida malabka oo kale.'

Duubkan waa ereyga Ilaah. Waa runta nolosha oo mararka qaarkood macaan sida malabka, laakiin mararka kale, marka ay taabato xaqiiqada xanuunka leh ee adduunkan, ay caloosha ka dhigto mid qadhaadh. Waxaan maanta halkan u nimid inaan ku dhex jirno labadaas dareen: macaanka jacaylka Ilaah iyo qadhaadhka maqnaanshaha Ben.

Benjamin Vo wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax aad u dhalaalaya, wiil jecel inuu barto waxyaabaha adag sida DevOps iyo ka shaqaynta cloud infrastructure. Laakiin waxaa ka sii qurux badnaa sida uu u jeclaa inuu waalidkiis la wadaago riyadiisa 'con chim airlines'. Markuu ka hadlayey shirkaddan yar ee uu ku riyoon jiray, wuxuu si tartiib ah u dhoola caddayn jiray, iyadoo indhihiisu ay ka buuxaan farxad nadiif ah. Waxaad xasuusan kartaan sawirka uu ku jiro isagoo xiran muraayadaha waaweyn ee madow, isagoo si dhab ah u eegaya adduunka, isagoo maskaxdiisa ku hayay riyooyin waaweyn. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil albaabka qalbigiisa u furay jacaylka iyo xikmadaha dunida.

Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu galayaa macbudka, wuxuuna ka saarayaa kuwa ka dhigtay 'god tuugo'. Wuxuu rabaa in gurigiisu noqdo meel lagu tukado. Macbudka dhabta ah ee Ilaah ma aha dhagax iyo qoryo; waa qalbiyadeenna. Ben wuxuu ahaa macbud nool oo jacaylka Ilaah ka muuqday. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aan ka baqin inuu bixiyo waxa uu haysto, sida markii uu u sheegay hooyadiis iyo aabbihiis inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo sanduuqiisa lacagta ku jirtay si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, lacagtiisana lama bixin sababtoo ah waxaa jiray caymis, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in shan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiinaysaan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen, haddii ay jirtay meel aad ka gaabiseen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Wuxuu weli kula joogaa markaad ciyaarayso, markaad wax baranayso, iyo markaad seexanayso. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada safrayeen ama ay wada ciyaarayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn.

Duubka uu Yooxanaa cunay wuxuu ahaa mid macaan afka, laakiin qadhaadh caloosha. Tani waa nolosha Masiixiga. Waxaan ku raaxaysanaa jacaylka Ben, xusuustiisa, iyo dhoola caddayntiisa—taasi waa macaanka. Laakiin maqnaanshihiisa waa qadhaadhka aan caloosha ku dareemayno. Laakiin ogow, in xitaa qadhaadhkaas uu qayb ka yahay qorshaha Ilaah. Ilaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'u adeegsanno' waxa la inoo dhiibay—jacaylka, xusuusta, iyo nolosha—si aan u dhisno boqortooyada Ilaah. Ben wuxuu inoo baray inaan ku kalsoonaano Ilaah.

Marka aad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-eedeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis.

Duubka waxaa lagu yiri: 'Waa inaad mar kale wax ka sii sheegtaa dad badan, quruumo, carrabo, iyo boqorro.' Ben xusuustiisu waxay inoo sheegaysaa in jacaylku aanu dhiman. Wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan sii wadno jacaylka, inaan sii wadno naxariista, iyo inaan sii wadno rajo-gelinta kuwa kale. Sida Ben u bixiyay jacaylkiisa, adinkuna bixiya jacaylkiinna. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaanan rabaa inaan kugu soo dhaweeyo naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kugu qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan u kaalay naftayda si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaanan isu dhiibayaa adiga gebi ahaanba. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa fogaado. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin dhawro, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga hor maray, inuu Rabbigu ku soo dhaweeyo iftiinka wejigiisa oo uu siiyo nasasho weligeed ah, Rabbi noo maqlo.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa xanuunka la ildaran, inuu Rabbigu siiyo xoog, rajo, iyo nabad qalbigooda, Rabbi noo maqlo.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Aniga, Yooxanaa, waxaan maqlay cod samada ka imanaya oo ila hadlaya. Codkii baa igu yiri, 'Tag, oo qaado duubka u furan gacanta malaa'igta taagan badda iyo dhulka.' Sidaas daraaddeed ayaan u tegey malaa'igtii, waxaanan ku iri ha i siiso duubka yar. Waxay igu tiri, 'Qaado oo liq; calooshaada ayuu ka dhigi doonaa mid qadhaadh, laakiin afkaaga wuxuu ka noqon doonaa sida malabka oo kale.' Waxaan duubkii yaraa ka qaatay gacantii malaa'igta, waanan liqay. Afkayga wuxuu ka ahaa sida malab macaan, laakiin markaan cunay, caloosha ayaa iga qadhaadhaatay. Markaasay cod iigu yiraahdeen, 'Waa inaad mar kale wax ka sii sheegtaa dad badan, quruumo, carrabo, iyo boqorro.'

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. (103a) Sidee bay ballankaagu u macaan yahay dhadhankayga! Jidka qaynuunnadaada ayaan ku farxaa, sidaan ugu farxo maal kasta. R. Sidee bay ballankaagu u macaan yahay dhadhankayga! Haa, qaynuunnadaadu waa farxaddayda; iyagu waa latashadayaashayda. R. Sidee bay ballankaagu u macaan yahay dhadhankayga! Sharciga afkaagu wuxuu ii yahay mid aad uga qaalisan kumanaan gogo' oo dahab iyo lacag ah. R. Sidee bay ballankaagu u macaan yahay dhadhankayga! Sidee bay ballankaagu u macaan yahay dhadhankayga, malab ka macaan afkayga! R. Sidee bay ballankaagu u macaan yahay dhadhankayga! Qaynuunnadaadu waa dhaxalkayga weligiis; iyagu waa farxadda qalbigayga. R. Sidee bay ballankaagu u macaan yahay dhadhankayga! Waxaan u neefsanayaa af furan, anigoo u hamuun qaba amarradaada. R. Sidee bay ballankaagu u macaan yahay dhadhankayga!

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu galay macbudka, wuxuuna bilaabay inuu ka saaro kuwa wax ka iibinayay, isagoo ku leh, 'Waxaa qoran, Gurigaygu wuxuu ahaan doonaa guri tukasho, laakiin idinku waxaad ka dhigteen god tuugo.' Maalin kastana wuxuu wax ku bari jiray macbudka. Wadaaddada sare, qorayaashii, iyo madaxdii dadka ayaa waxay doonayeen inay dilaan, laakiin ma ay helin siday u samayn lahaayeen, waayo dadka oo dhan ayaa u dheg taagayay hadalladiisa.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
